consequence.statement: The controller's RBAC is granted the new terminationGracePeriod permissions; the release note describes no operator action, rejection, or failure — only the addition of permissions as a bug fix.
consequence.remediation: No operator action described; upgrading grants the added permissions via the chart's RBAC objects.

original.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 adds "terminationGracePeriod RBAC permissions" (bug fix, PR #6538) to the product's controller RBAC; the release note names no specific resource, verb, role, or consequence beyond the addition.

decision.reason: The linked PR [ev-3152f9abdc25] says this bug fix "Adds the missing pod delete rbac permissions", and its only changed file is the chart's charts/karpenter/templates/clusterrole-core.yaml [ev-f7b28f897879]. The upgrade guide lists it as "RBAC changes: added `delete pods`" [ev-873cf7661375]. For an environment exposed through the rendered ClusterRole, upgrading the chart grants the permission itself. No evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so "none" (informational) fits; it does not hide a stated failure.
